summary: DrainIterator::next recursively calls itself when entering a child node. Calls can accumulate across successive subtrees visited without yielding, so call-stack growth is not limited to tree depth and can cause stack overflow. The fix continues the outer loop instead, retaining traversal state in node_stack without recursive calls. The commit adds no tests. Inspection found algorithm::removal::test::test_drain_iterator and removal tests, but no existing test established to expose the overflow at this revision. Leave test empty to block pending a detecting upstream test; no builds or tests were run.
